svg.text: MAIN SECTION: TRUNCATED BASE WITH MICROPILE A-FRAME
panel depth D, I3 to I5
1. A-frame carries the impact to the ground; soil and reinforcement not counted. Ld per A-C Table 4 over 10.83 ft [AF1].
2. Micropiles AASHTO 10.9: grout 6 ksi; bond 16.5 psi unless geotech; L1 = L2 per table, 10 ft minimum.
3. Spacing 5'-0" staggered; up to 10'-0" with deep-seated FS > 1.3. 4. Verification tests: 1 per 100 ft, 2 per wall.
5. Record bedrock elevations. 6. Phase I piles, Phase II wall; roadway after 45 days or 90% settlement.
7. Reinforcement and drains may be modified around piles. 8. Casing into bedrock to the start of the bond length.
Pile table on the sheet: station, cap elevation, bedrock (estimated, actual), bond, micropile and casing pay lengths.
OPTION TABLES: FACING AND TOP OF WALL
TABLE: A-FRAME MICROPILES BY TEST LEVEL
8 in pile, 16.5 psi bond, φ 1.0; spread 10.83 ft [Decide AF1]. Wall quantities: B2 / B3 tables.
Final sheet: the three-force solution per test level (scaled estimates here).
EQUATIONS (per pile; s = pile spacing, ft)
A1. T = 9.970 s (Ld / 54) battered pile tension, kips
A2. C = 8.663 s (Ld / 54) vertical pile compression, kips
V2's forces for 54 kips, scaled by Ld (A-C Table 4)
A3. φ αb​ π d Lb​ ≥ T, φ = 1.0 (AASHTO 11.5.8, extreme event)
αb​ = 16.5 psi nominal unless the geotech report gives more; d = 8 in
A4. Lb​ = T / (φ αb​ π d) ≥ 10 ft (L1 = L2)
A5. s = φ αb​ π d Lb​ / (9.970 Ld / 54) spacing for a given bond
Seals, designer, detailer, checker, dates (standard block)
Replaces: A3, A5, D3, D5, L3, L5 (with V2 / V6 design notes)
Revised for AASHTO LRFD 10th and MASH
PILOT LAYOUT MOCKUP: blocks and contents in place, not to scale
